channel.title: JFrog Artifactory on Open Component Model
channel.description: Recent content in JFrog Artifactory on Open Component Model

item.title: Upload Helm Charts to JFrog Artifactory
item.description:
Goal

Transfer a component version and upload its Helm chart into an Artifactory helm repository, so that helm pull finds it.

item.title: Upload Maven Artifacts to JFrog Artifactory
item.description:
Goal

Transfer a component version and upload a JAR and its POM into an Artifactory maven repository, so that Maven resolves the artifact from its coordinates.

item.title: Upload npm Packages to JFrog Artifactory
item.description:
Goal

Transfer a component version and upload its npm package into an Artifactory npm repository, so that npm install finds it.

item.title: Upload Generic Files to JFrog Artifactory
item.description:
Goal

Transfer a component version and upload its resources as plain files into an Artifactory generic repository, so that consumers download them by URL.
